title: Nutty Crumbly Thai Lamb Curry
description: A comforting Thai-inspired curry with aromatic coconut milk, nutty peanut sauce, and crumbly toasted coconut topping, perfect for a sick day.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the lamb mince, breaking it apart with a wooden spoon; cook until browned, 5-7 minutes.
Pour in the red curry paste and stir to coat the meat, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and brown sugar; bring to a gentle simmer.
Let the curry simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Stir in the lime juice, then season with salt to taste.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice, topping each portion with crushed peanuts, toasted coconut flakes, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Enjoy a comforting, nutty, and slightly crunchy Thai lamb curry that’s soothing on a sick day.
